systemDefaults.name: Show hidden files
systemDefaults.detail: Dotfiles visible in Finder without pressing Cmd-Shift-period.

systemDefaults.name: Show path bar and status bar
systemDefaults.detail: Adds the full path and item count at the bottom of every window.
systemDefaults.command: defaults write com.apple.finder ShowPathbar -bool true; defaults write com.apple.finder ShowStatusBar -bool true
systemDefaults.revert: defaults write com.apple.finder ShowPathbar -bool false; defaults write com.apple.finder ShowStatusBar -bool false

systemDefaults.name: Default to list view
systemDefaults.detail: Opens new windows in list view rather than icon view.

systemDefaults.name: Keep folders on top when sorting
systemDefaults.detail: Folders sort above loose files, Windows-style.

systemDefaults.name: Don't write .DS_Store on network or USB volumes
systemDefaults.detail: Stops littering shared drives. Worth setting on every business machine.
systemDefaults.command: defaults write com.apple.desktopservices DSDontWriteNetworkStores -bool true; defaults write com.apple.desktopservices DSDontWriteUSBStores -bool true
systemDefaults.revert: defaults write com.apple.desktopservices DSDontWriteNetworkStores -bool false; defaults write com.apple.desktopservices DSDontWriteUSBStores -bool false

systemDefaults.name: Fast Dock auto-hide
systemDefaults.command: defaults write com.apple.dock autohide -bool true; defaults write com.apple.dock autohide-delay -float 0; defaults write com.apple.dock autohide-time-modifier -float 0.15
systemDefaults.revert: defaults delete com.apple.dock autohide-delay; defaults delete com.apple.dock autohide-time-modifier

systemDefaults.name: Minimise windows into the app icon
systemDefaults.detail: Keeps the Dock from filling up with minimised windows.

systemDefaults.name: Fast key repeat
systemDefaults.detail: Sets repeat rate and delay to the quickest values the UI allows.
systemDefaults.command: defaults write NSGlobalDomain KeyRepeat -int 2; defaults write NSGlobalDomain InitialKeyRepeat -int 15
systemDefaults.revert: defaults delete NSGlobalDomain KeyRepeat; defaults delete NSGlobalDomain InitialKeyRepeat

systemDefaults.name: Disable press-and-hold accent picker
systemDefaults.detail: Holding a key repeats it instead of offering accented characters. Useful for developers.

systemDefaults.name: Tap to click
systemDefaults.detail: Enables tapping on the trackpad and at the login window.
systemDefaults.command: defaults write com.apple.driver.AppleBluetoothMultitouch.trackpad Clicking -bool true; defaults -currentHost write NSGlobalDomain com.apple.mouse.tapBehavior -int 1
systemDefaults.revert: defaults write com.apple.driver.AppleBluetoothMultitouch.trackpad Clicking -bool false; defaults -currentHost write NSGlobalDomain com.apple.mouse.tapBehavior -int 0

systemDefaults.name: Disable autocorrect and smart quotes
systemDefaults.detail: Stops macOS rewriting quotes and dashes in code and terminal input.
systemDefaults.command: defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticSpellingCorrectionEnabled -bool false; defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticQuoteSubstitutionEnabled -bool false; defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticDashSubstitutionEnabled -bool false
systemDefaults.revert: defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticSpellingCorrectionEnabled -bool true; defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticQuoteSubstitutionEnabled -bool true; defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticDashSubstitutionEnabled -bool true

systemDefaults.name: Save screenshots to ~/Screenshots
systemDefaults.detail: Creates the folder and points screen capture at it instead of the Desktop.

systemDefaults.name: No drop shadow on window screenshots
systemDefaults.detail: Removes the large transparent border around captured windows.

systemDefaults.name: Expand save and print dialogs by default
systemDefaults.detail: Always shows the full file browser rather than the compact sheet.
systemDefaults.command: defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSNavPanelExpandedStateForSaveMode -bool true; defaults write NSGlobalDomain PMPrintingExpandedStateForPrint -bool true
systemDefaults.revert: defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSNavPanelExpandedStateForSaveMode -bool false; defaults write NSGlobalDomain PMPrintingExpandedStateForPrint -bool false

systemDefaults.name: Save to disk, not iCloud, by default
systemDefaults.detail: New documents default to a local folder.

systemDefaults.name: Don't ask before opening each downloaded app
systemDefaults.detail: Suppresses the repeated 'are you sure you want to open this' prompt. Leave off on shared machines.
